channel.title: Live: MOTD FIFA World Cup 2026
channel.desc: Live coverage as Morocco play Haiti in their final Group C match at Atlanta Stadium. Morocco had won just two of their 16 World Cup games prior to becoming the first African nation to reach a World Cup semi-final in 2022, losing 2-0 to France in Qatar. In their only previous World Cup appearance, in 1974, Haiti lost all three group games and conceded 14 goals. The 52-year gap between Haiti's first and second appearance at the World Cup is the fourth-longest in the tournament's history.
